biome_register: Stillsand register: a still, sun-bleached sand desert; ash, bone and pale violet-grey under hard white light; reads against pale sand by value and a dark rim
prompt: RimWorld plant sprite seen from above at a gentle three-quarter angle: a low, wide clump of five to seven squat, rounded bulbs, pale ash-violet with faint darker violet streaks, each bulb half-sunk so only its rounded top and shoulders show, nestled tightly together. Thin papery sheath leaves, dry parchment-beige with violet-grey tips, peel and curl outward off the bulbs like loose onion skin, a few curling ribbons lying flat. The clump is wider than tall, filling about 80 percent of the canvas width, centred, its base in the lower part of the canvas. Muted, dusty, desert-dry colours; the bulbs are matte and smooth, never spotted, never star-shaped.

biome_register: FeverWood register: a hot, humid fever-swamp forest; deep wet greens, mud browns and sickly ochre with one strong warm accent; reads against dark wet mud by value and rim
prompt: RimWorld plant sprite of a marsh herb: a dense upright ruff of long, glossy, ribbed dark-green blades, each blade broad, strap-like and pleated lengthwise with a pale midrib, fanning up and outward like a fountain of leaves. At the base a single swollen, rounded root crown bulges up out of the ground, banded in alternating deep crimson and dark plum-brown rings, smooth and wet-looking, partly sunk so only its top dome shows. The blades rise from the crown's top. Centred, the crown in the lower third of the canvas, the leaf ruff filling the upper two thirds. The crown is one single round dome with no legs or forks.

biome_register: LongShade register: an arid land of long low-sun shadows; sun-scorched ochre, rust, bleached bone and dusty olive; reads against cracked pale dirt by value and rim
prompt: RimWorld plant sprite of a ground-hugging desert vine seen from above: a flat sprawl of tough, leathery, dusty-olive leaves, small and narrow-lobed, sun-scorched brown at their edges, on wiry grey-brown runners that spread low in a loose star. Resting among the runners are three hard gourds of different sizes, elongated and ridged like a cantaloupe-shaped melon stretched long, dust-ochre with paler bleached bone-white ribs running end to end, matte and dry. Centred, filling about 85 percent of the canvas width, flat and wider than tall.

biome_register: FeverWood register: a hot, humid fever-swamp forest; deep wet greens, mud browns and sickly ochre with one strong warm accent; reads against dark wet mud by value and rim
prompt: RimWorld tree sprite: a tall, narrow dye tree. A pale ash-grey trunk rises straight from a flared root base; down its bark run vivid rust-orange weeping streaks and drips, as if the tree bleeds dye. Halfway up, the trunk splits into four or five limbs that twist around one another like braided rope, spiralling upward and outward, each limb itself grey with rust-orange stains. The crown is sparse and open: long, narrow, blade-like leaves, dark olive-green, hanging straight down in loose tassels from the limb tips, so the braided limbs stay clearly visible through the crown. Tall vertical silhouette, the trunk base at the bottom centre of the canvas and the crown reaching near the top, the whole tree about 70 percent of the canvas wide.

biome_register: FeverWood register: a hot, humid fever-swamp forest; deep wet greens, mud browns and sickly ochre with one strong warm accent; reads against dark wet mud by value and rim
prompt: RimWorld tree sprite: a dye tree with a short, thick, silvery-grey trunk scarred with long rust-orange weeping stains running down to its roots. From low on the trunk, three thick limbs twist tightly together like a braided cable, coiling upward in a corkscrew, then fray apart near the top into thinner rope-like strands. From every strand hang long, slender, drooping blade-leaves, dark teal-green, few in number, forming a thin weeping curtain rather than a dense canopy. Tall vertical silhouette with the trunk base at bottom centre and the crown near the top of the canvas, about 65 percent of the canvas wide.

biome_register: FeverWood register: a hot, humid fever-swamp forest; deep wet greens, mud browns and sickly ochre with one strong warm accent; reads against dark wet mud by value and rim
prompt: RimWorld tree sprite of a broad fruit tree: one short, straight, smooth trunk with grey-green bark, smooth as a beech, rising to a wide, flat-topped umbrella crown that is much wider than it is tall. The crown is a dense dome of small dark green leaves, deep shadowed underneath. Hanging beneath the crown's rim in clusters of three to five are pale gold, teardrop-shaped fruits on short stems, smooth and glowing softly in the shade. The crown spans about 90 percent of the canvas width in the upper half; the trunk base sits at the bottom centre of the canvas.

biome_register: FeverWood register: a hot, humid fever-swamp forest; deep wet greens, mud browns and sickly ochre with one strong warm accent; reads against dark wet mud by value and rim
prompt: RimWorld tree sprite of a broad orchard-like fruit tree: a stout smooth trunk of grey-green bark that divides into several smooth spreading branches, holding up a broad rounded umbrella canopy of dense, glossy, very dark green foliage. Under the canopy edge hang many pale gold, teardrop fruits, plump and pointed at the bottom, in loose bunches. Wide silhouette, crown spanning nearly the full canvas width, trunk base at the bottom centre.

biome_register: LeaningScrub register: a windswept scrubland of bent, leaning growth; dusty sage, silver-blue, straw and dark earth; reads against dry earth by value and rim
prompt: RimWorld plant sprite of a medicinal scrub herb: a loose, wiry bush of thin, branching silver-blue stems, slightly bent to one side as if by wind, with sparse tiny grey-blue needle leaves. Along the upper stems sit fat, segmented seed pods, plump and ribbed like stacked beads, dusty blue-grey; several pods have split open lengthwise to show a soft milky-white interior. Centred, the bush filling about 80 percent of the canvas, its base in the lower part of the canvas. A low rounded bush, never a dense field of upright stalks.

biome_register: Webwork register: a silk-strung jungle in permanent gloom under a sealed dark-green canopy; bone-pale, dull green and mud-dark; must read against dark leaf litter by value and rim
prompt: RimWorld plant sprite of an ornamental carnivorous plant seen from above at a gentle three-quarter angle: a symmetric rosette of six to eight translucent glassy cup-traps on short pale stalks, each cup like a hollow pitcher of frosted glass, its rim lined with fine glassy teeth that curl inward. The glass is pale and clear, tinted faint sea-green, and each rim glows softly green-amber. Beneath the cups lies a low ring of small smooth dark-green leaves. Beautiful, delicate and slightly menacing. Centred, filling about 80 percent of the canvas, wider than tall.
